### Goal
Fix the dunning scheduler emailing customers who already paid; then finish invoice histogram verification and resume incremental `routes.py` splitting.

### Constraints and rules
Run Terraform sequentially. Never seed/write frozen `billing_v1`; use `billing_v3`. Keep `invoice_reconcile_seconds` labels limited to `service`, `environment`, `status`, `tenant_tier`. Config/deploy TOML/YAML/JSON files must stay under 120 lines. Do not retry entire webhook handlers or duplicate customer emails.

### Key decisions and facts
CLI billing arguments use shared parsing helpers; abbreviations remain supported. Webhook sender retries only transport errors and retryable server errors, not client errors. Terraform VPC plan applied successfully: 3 resources added.

### Ruled out
Pre-persistence event popping, shared-list retention, whole-handler webhook retries, and HTTP 4xx retries.

### Progress
Webhook tests: 6 passed. Full suite reached 42 passed, 1 failure, then the 4xx retry defect was fixed; a 500/502/204 retry test was added but the full suite has not been rerun. CLI regression and Ruff checks pass.

### Next steps
Inspect `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` and payment-state logic, add a regression test, and fix it. Re-run webhook/full tests afterward.
